_comment: Fictional company, customers and people. All text is plain ASCII on purpose (the server mis-decodes a lone non-ASCII character in short texts).

dana.name: Dana Ruiz
dana.description: Senior support agent at Tallyfold (fictional). Handled both customers' September tickets.

leo.name: Leo Park
leo.description: Support agent at Tallyfold (fictional), started this week. Handles today's tickets.

known_issues.workaround: Settings > Invoices > PDF renderer > Legacy, then export again
known_issues.text: KI-101 (open): PDF invoice export shows blank totals in Safari 17 and later on app 4.2. Workaround: Settings > Invoices > PDF renderer > Legacy, then export again.

known_issues.workaround: Settings > Invoices > PDF renderer > Standard, then export again
known_issues.text: KI-109 (open): The Legacy PDF renderer drops the VAT lines from invoices that mix currencies, so the PDF total no longer matches the ledger. Never switch a multi-currency account to the Legacy renderer.

known_issues.workaround: Settings > Billing > Default currency, pick one, then export again
known_issues.text: KI-117 (open): Invoice totals come out empty in any browser when an account bills in more than one currency and has no default currency set. Workaround: Settings > Billing > Default currency, pick one, then export again.

known_issues.workaround: trim the customer name in Tallyfold, then run the sync again
known_issues.text: KI-122 (fixed in 4.3): QuickBooks sync creates duplicate customers when a customer name ends with a space. Workaround on 4.2: trim the name in Tallyfold, then run the sync again.

customers.name: Marlow Dental Group
customers.description: Tallyfold customer (fictional): a three-site dental practice. Contact: Priya Shah, office manager.

ticket.title: T-4388 Marlow Dental Group - recurring invoices setup
turns: customer
Priya Shah (office manager, Marlow Dental Group): Hi, we want monthly recurring invoices for our ortho patients on payment plans. We run Tallyfold in Safari 17 on the front-desk Macs.
agent
Dana Ruiz (support, Tallyfold): Happy to help. Recurring invoices are under Invoices > Recurring. Do you bill in one currency?
customer
Priya Shah (office manager, Marlow Dental Group): USD only, all three sites are in Ohio. And please answer us by email, the front desk cannot take calls during clinic hours.
agent
Dana Ruiz (support, Tallyfold): Noted, email only. I set up the first plan with you; the next invoices go out on the 1st of each month.
customer
Priya Shah (office manager, Marlow Dental Group): Perfect. We do not use any accounting integration, our bookkeeper exports CSV once a month.

environment.text: Marlow Dental Group runs Tallyfold in Safari 17 on the front-desk Macs.
Marlow Dental Group invoices in USD only.
Marlow Dental Group has USD set as its default currency.
Marlow Dental Group uses no accounting integration; its bookkeeper exports CSV monthly.
Marlow Dental Group wants support replies by email only, never by phone during clinic hours.

today.text: Since this morning the totals on our PDF invoices are blank. The line items are there but Subtotal, Tax and Total are empty.

customers.name: Copperleaf Bakery
customers.description: Tallyfold customer (fictional): a wholesale bakery selling to cafes in Ireland and the US. Contact: Tomas Byrne, owner.

ticket.title: T-4471 Copperleaf Bakery - wholesale invoices in two currencies
turns: customer
Tomas Byrne (owner, Copperleaf Bakery): Hello, we are opening wholesale accounts with cafes in Dublin. Those invoices have to be in EUR, our US cafes stay in USD. Can one Tallyfold account do both?
agent
Dana Ruiz (support, Tallyfold): Yes, you can set the currency per customer. Which browser do you use, so I can send the right screenshots?
customer
Tomas Byrne (owner, Copperleaf Bakery): Chrome 129 on a Windows laptop. We also sync every invoice to QuickBooks.
agent
Dana Ruiz (support, Tallyfold): Great. I set EUR on your four Dublin cafes. You have not picked a default currency yet; that is optional.
customer
Tomas Byrne (owner, Copperleaf Bakery): Leave it unset for now. And keep replies short, numbered steps please, I read them on my phone at 5am.

environment.text: Copperleaf Bakery runs Tallyfold in Chrome 129 on a Windows laptop.
Copperleaf Bakery invoices in EUR (Dublin cafes) and USD (US cafes).
Copperleaf Bakery has not set a default currency in Tallyfold.
Copperleaf Bakery syncs every invoice to QuickBooks.
Copperleaf Bakery wants short replies with numbered steps; the owner reads them on his phone.

today.text: Our PDF invoices show blank totals. The line items print fine but the Total box is empty. Can you help?

come_back_question: What did we tell this customer about blank PDF totals, and what did we decide not to suggest?
